senses.en: vehicles moving along a road or in an area

example.en: The traffic was heavy during the morning rush.

senses.en: illegal trade, especially in drugs, weapons, or people
senses.zh: 非法交易；贩运（尤指毒品、武器或人口）

example.en: Police are investigating the traffic in stolen art.
example.zh: 警方正在调查被盗艺术品的非法交易。

senses.en: to trade goods or people illegally

example.en: He was arrested for trafficking in stolen goods.

senses.en: the movement of data over a network, or visits to a website

example.en: The website gets more traffic on weekends.
example.zh: 这个网站在周末的访问量更高。

senses.en: a person taught by a teacher, especially a child at school
senses.zh: 学生；门生（尤指在校儿童）

example.en: The teacher asked each pupil to read a sentence aloud.
example.zh: 老师让每个学生大声读一个句子。

senses.en: the dark round opening in the center of the eye

example.en: The doctor shone a light into her pupil.
example.zh: 医生用光照了照她的瞳孔。

senses.en: during the time that; at the same time as

example.en: She read while I cooked dinner.

senses.en: a period of time, usually a short one

example.en: While the idea is good, it costs too much.
example.zh: 虽然这个主意不错，但花费太高。

senses.en: to pass time in a relaxed or leisurely way

example.en: We whiled away the afternoon at the beach.
example.zh: 我们在海滩上消磨了一下午。

senses.en: a person who flies an aircraft

example.en: The pilot landed the plane safely in heavy rain.
example.zh: 飞行员在大雨中安全地让飞机着陆。

senses.en: to fly an aircraft or guide a ship or boat

example.en: He piloted the small boat through the narrow channel.
example.zh: 他驾驶小船穿过狭窄的航道。

senses.en: done or used as a test before a full launch

example.en: The school started a pilot program for online lessons.
example.zh: 学校启动了一个在线课程的试点项目。

senses.en: a television episode made to test whether a series will be successful

example.en: The network ordered a full series after watching the pilot.
example.zh: 电视台看了试播集后订了整季。

senses.en: the shape or appearance of something

example.en: The ice took the form of a swan.

senses.en: a paper or electronic document with spaces or fields for information

example.en: Please fill out this form at the desk.
example.zh: 请在服务台填写这张表格。

senses.en: a type or kind of something

example.en: This is a common form of exercise.
example.zh: 这是一种常见的运动形式。

example.en: The students formed a small study group.
example.zh: 学生们组成了一个学习小组。
